part.text:
Fix verified. 

**Root cause:** `cp`'s positional argument `PATHS` in `src/uu/cp/src/cp.rs:678` didn't declare `num_args(1..)`. With the default single-value num_args, `clap_complete`'s zsh generator emitted `':paths:_files'` — a completion spec for one positional only. Once the user supplied `cp file`, no remaining positional spec existed, so zsh fell back to flag-only completion.

**Fix:** added `.num_args(1..)` to the `PATHS` arg (same as `mv`'s `ARG_FILES`), which makes the generator emit the catch-all `'*::paths:_files'` so file completion works after any number of arguments. Verified the generated zsh completion changed accordingly, `cp` parsing behavior is unchanged, and the full cp test suite shows no new failures (5 failures are pre-existing baseline failures, unrelated permission tests).
